# easyhoudini MCP

> An MCP server for SideFX Houdini. Connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, opencode and pi to a running Houdini. It builds readable node graphs, follows studio USD practice in Solaris, records a timelapse of every session and asks the user before it goes on.

Install: tell your AI agent "Install the Houdini MCP from https://github.com/rozhabrev/easyhoudini_mcp following its README, and connect it to my Houdini."
Or: `uv tool install git+https://github.com/rozhabrev/easyhoudini_mcp && houdinimcp-install`

- About 20 tools with modes: scene_overview, node_inspect, geometry_inspect, stage_inspect, node_edit, parm_set, connect, cook, render, pdg, capture, execute, docs, rules, session and more.
- House rules for agents: src/bridge/rules.md (core) and src/bridge/rules/ (modeling, USD, look, destruction, PDG, scripting).
- Pictures of the viewport go back to the agent, even on another machine.
- Your own tools: a Python function marked @tool in a tools folder becomes a tool for the agent (custom).
- Timelapse of every session; parallel render variants through TOPs; offline Houdini help through houdinimd-docs.
- Error log with hints for frequent agent mistakes.
- Houdini 22, Windows, macOS, Linux. MIT License.
- Tested first by the students of easyhoudini, a Houdini + AI course by Rodion Zhabrev: https://www.youtube.com/@rodionzhabrev
